title: The wisdom of not knowing
gist: Bryan Appleyard reviews two books by physicist Carlo Rovelli: 'On the Equality of All Things', which argues for abandoning certainty in favour of a perspectival, anti-foundationalist view of reality, and '85 Seconds to Midnight', a pamphlet against rearmament arguing nuclear war killing billions is now very likely, with weapons in the hands of Putin and Trump.

insights.claim: Physicist Carlo Rovelli argues in '85 Seconds to Midnight' that billions of deaths from nuclear weapons are now very likely, bordering on inevitable, and that nuclear war is more likely than not.
insights.speaker: Bryan Appleyard
insights.so_what: A prominent scientific voice amplifying nuclear tail-risk narratives amid rearmament; relevant to anti-rearmament political sentiment and defence-sector debate.
